title: Allow clicking with a mouse when using WindowHopper

judgment.rationale: The request is to add mouse selection to Window Hopper, not to correct an unintended defect. Current AltWindowCycle code explicitly makes the thumbnail host disabled/click-through so it does not consume mouse input; the current bug-triage/design workflow is for fixes, not feature approval.
evidence: The issue asks to select a window by clicking it, comparing the desired interaction to Alt+Tab.
The author says clicks currently produce the exclamation sound and replies that the existing repro is sufficient; the author also added a bug report ZIP.
The current src/modules/AltWindowCycle/AltWindowCycle.cpp comment says WS_DISABLED keeps the thumbnail host from swallowing mouse input so clicks pass through its transparent areas.
judgment.recommended_action: Route as a product-feature request for maintainers to decide whether mouse selection belongs in Window Hopper; do not create a bug-fix design or request the same repro again.

fix_assessment.rationale: The observed click-through policy on the thumbnail host is intentional. Adding click-to-select is a new interaction feature requiring product direction rather than a demonstrated bug fix.

issue_context.summary: The reporter wants Window Hopper's keyboard-driven window-switcher overlay to support mouse-click selection; the current implementation intentionally makes its thumbnail host click-through.
known_information: The issue reports PowerToys 0.101.2362.0 from WinGet and requests selecting a window by clicking its entry.
The author states that clicking plays the system exclamation sound, rejects the automated request for more repro detail, and says a bug report ZIP was added.
The upstream module source is src/modules/AltWindowCycle, whose file metadata identifies the product as Window Hopper.
inferences: The requested behavior appears to be an enhancement rather than a regression because the module explicitly disables the display-only host to avoid swallowing mouse input.
issue_context.analysis: The expected interaction is understandable, but approving a fix design would treat a product-direction decision as a defect. The current source has an explicit input-disabled policy; no linked fix or fork mirror was found.
initial_investigation: Inspected current upstream src/modules/AltWindowCycle/AltWindowCycle.cpp; the thumbHost preview window is created with WS_DISABLED because WS_EX_NOACTIVATE alone does not make it click-through.
The feature maps to AltWindowCycle despite the issue's Window Hopper name; this is not an absent/unowned module.
The author already supplied the requested reproduction response and states a ZIP was uploaded, so no duplicate information request is proposed.

status.label: Feature request
status.detail: Mouse-click selection requires product direction; current display-only input behavior is intentional.

next_action.label: Maintainer product triage
next_action.reason: Decide whether click-to-select is in scope before starting implementation work.
